comment: Third-party Claude Code skills vendored into this project after a security review (research_lab/DAY_TRADER_SKILL_REVIEW.md). tests/test_vendored_skills.py fails if any file drifts from these hashes. To upgrade: re-review the new upstream commit, copy byte-identical files, update commit and hashes here.

rejected.trader-broker: order path to an external brokerage MCP server (Alpaca via unpinned `uvx alpaca-mcp-server`) with API keys; violates the no-credentials, no-order-permission rule
rejected.trader-risk: blocks every non-US-stock ticker (crypto explicitly); duplicates tradebot/risk/engine.py
rejected.trader-budget: whole-share stock sizing to Alpaca order JSON, 75% default position cap, no fees; duplicates RiskEngine sizing
rejected.trader-scanner: Nasdaq Trader stock universe, ticker regex rejects crypto, NYSE session; duplicates tradebot/scanner
rejected.trader-entry: NYSE 9:30 opening-range timer on Yahoo stock bars; duplicates tradebot strategies/scanner signals
rejected.trader-exit: NYSE flat-by and cent-rounded stock stops; duplicates TRADEBOT stops/targets
rejected.trader-alerts: NYSE hours and stock quotes; TRADEBOT manages exits and the kill switch itself
rejected.trader-news: Yahoo stock headlines plus SEC 8-K filings; stock-specific, not needed in the trading loop
rejected.trader-analyst: SEC XBRL company financials; not applicable to SOL/BTC/ETH
rejected.trader-pelosi: US House stock-trade disclosures; not applicable; also shells out to a local pdftotext binary
